scope: Fixed schema23-to24 source, migration-purpose dependency interfaces, normal backup compatibility and historical fixture freeze

checked.reason: Release inventory requires exact sequential 1..23 source or 1..24 target; fixed embedded SQL24 digest agrees with v4's migration and MigrationSQLSHA256. Original and restored schema fingerprints are independently derived from pinned migration/session bytes. DDL transaction requires exact integer23 version set, unchanged source schema/typed rows, then exactly24 version set, target schema and integrity/FK checks.

SQL rows encode actual storage type, int64 decimal, float64 bits, length-prefixed raw TEXT/BLOB, and NULL; declared type hints are stripped. Sorted digest multisets retain duplicates. All pre-existing table columns/rows must remain identical except schema_migrations retains every old row plus one version24 row. Only new empty runtime_prepared_abandonments is allowed; schema fingerprint covers all schema objects.

Rehearsal acquires current source data-root lease and exclusive SQLite ownership, snapshots original schema and typed rows, creates encrypted local-upgrade backup, and performs normal restore only into the fresh isolated destination. Private workspace preservation is fixed-plan checked and validates the unchanged original workspace identity; it does not skip recovery. afterRecovery occurs after normal relocation, backupFence, acceptance checks and source-path publication. Restore effects get their own typed post-restore baseline and delta; rollback probe plus committed DDL must preserve this baseline. Original23 schema/rows are repeatedly checked unchanged, no copy-back or automatic promotion.

Independent opaque MigrationToken has private state; cannot convert to abandonment Token. Grant purpose RESEARCHOS_PREPARED_SCHEMA23_TO24_V1, fixed plan/SQL, APPLY_ORIGINAL stage, expiry, nonce and exact options/release/inventory/schema/original-row/raw pins are validated by concrete native dependency. Receiver checks enrolled root/control images, actual native process and root/DB identities, purpose-separated inherited channel, retained raw-pin guards and borrowed current DataRootLease. This review verifies the migration-facing contract, not the entire native authority implementation or enrolled operational authority.

Original apply accepts a sole persistent SQLite connection, exact main database path, no attached or temporary schema, and retained exclusive locking. Exact grant pins must include source/target inventory, accepted program bytes, SQL and every encrypted payload. Backup manifest MAC/decryption and rehearsal receipt strict JSON/plan/schema/options/version/hash bindings are checked. Current nondelegated Root OWNER and project permission are authenticated under resource write lock. Token checks surround DDL; only additive migration executes on original, with no backupFence/restore or abandonment/domain-status mutation.

Fresh exclusive intent directory makes existing attempts an inspection boundary. Immutable intent precedes DDL; result distinguishes not committed, committed, and COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. Any commit attempt conservatively consumes token via Finish(commitAttempted), including commit error; before-commit failures roll back. Receipt persistence failure is returned, never silently reported as full success. Native Root separately journals grant nonce; actual crash/durability behavior is not tested here.

Normal backup permits at most exact sequential version24 and validates SQL24-derived proof table, autoindexes and all six triggers including four external-table triggers. Existing configuration/queue checks continue; altered24 fingerprints and version25 deny. Embedded SQL bytes match the independently pinned v4 migration.

Historical startup-guard fixture now enumerates a fixed schema23 release produced by configurationUpgradeReleaseFixture(t,23); that helper uses queueUpgradeReleaseFixture(t,22), so it does not recurse. Assertions retain the original 23-migration contract despite candidate0024 in checkout.

Tests cover lossless type hashes, DDL business/credential/sealed-bytes preservation, old and new immutable triggers, exact failure rollback, rehearsal rollback, release inventory rejection, old-row mutation rejection, exact24 backup/future25, public encrypted normal restore vs unchanged original QUEUED state/credentials, competing lease denial, zero token denial, startup prebackup refusal and normal24 backup. Positive enrolled MigrationToken original-apply integration is not exercised by the zero-token test.

good_patterns: Restore side effects and migration invariance use distinct baselines and explicit receipts.
Typed row snapshots avoid JSON number coercion and preserve byte-sensitive immutable content.
Original apply requires separate native purpose plus fresh Owner authorization and conservatively reports commit uncertainty.

remaining_gates: Root must append independently sealed actual selected new-migration tests and relevant historical configuration/backup regression results before component runtime acceptance.

Native authority implementation/enrollment and positive original-schema-apply integration remain separately reviewed and validated gates; signed JSON or source hashes alone do not establish native runtime authority.

Any original production migration requires its separately authorized current Root/Owner grant, accepted programs, held pins, matching encrypted backup and independently reviewed rehearsal; this receipt grants no execution authority.
Existing trial abandonment, provider execution/financial accounting closure and formal project acceptance remain outside this review; historical provider NULL is not changed to zero.
